All *** significance, N=100 each. Legend (AMIE top red, PCP bottom blue) shown in this region.

description: Patient-actor ratings of AMIE (top bars) versus PCPs (bottom bars) across GMCPQ, MXEKF and PACES items, shown as 100% stacked bars of five favorability levels plus "cannot rate" in % of consultations.
uncertain: Segment lengths were estimated from bar edges, not printed, so each is approximate; segments under about 2% and the split between hatched Unfavorable and Very unfavorable are the least certain.
The automatic sum check flagged every category at 200 because AMIE and PCP are two separate bars per category in the same chart; each bar was read to sum to about 100.
Significance stars (*** and one **) and N values per item are noted in the chart notes but not recorded as data points.
